rows.en:
"...Why didn't you kill me!"
Hino screamed.
Then he glared at me and bit down on his lip in frustration.
Blood dripped from the lip he bit so hard.
"...Because you're not even worth killing."
"Just watch! I'll curse you! I'll curse you to death!"
Hino yanked out the screwdriver stuck in his shoulder and drove it into his own ear.{p}

"...I...'ll... cur...se... you... to... de......ath..."
He collapsed.
It wasn't as if I couldn't have seen it coming, Hino taking his own life.
But I couldn't stop him.
I had no chance to stop him, and even if I had, would I have stopped him?
"...If you want to curse me, go ahead and curse me. I'm not afraid of your curse.
Thanks to you, I've found the confidence to live strong."
No answer came back from Hino.
By now he must be riding the train to hell.{p}

I stepped into the payphone outside the school gate.
The morning sun was already starting to show beyond the sky.{p}

I dialed.
"...Hello, police? There's been a murder at the school. The school is at..."{p}

I told them everything and hung up.
I was unbelievably sleepy.
Staying awake was too hard now.
I pulled the window frame that had saved my life out from under my shirt.
To think this rotten piece of wood, ready to snap at any moment, had saved me.
It really was a miracle.{p}

I sank down inside the phone booth as if I were collapsing.
...Even keeping my eyes open was hard now.
I closed my eyes.
And I fell into a deep sleep.
When I wake up, maybe I'll skip school, just for today.
...As my consciousness faded, the wail of police sirens rang through my head.{p}

"I don't need it. Not something like that!"
I turned my face away.
"So tough. How cool."
At Hino's mocking tone, someone giggled.{p}

"Then just die."
Iwashita said it coldly.
How can she look at me with a face like that?
Those aren't the eyes you look at a human being with★
"No way, that'd be a problem."
Fukuzawa pouted.
"That's right. It'd be no fun if you died off that easily."
Is this really Hino?
The same Hino, our senior, who coached us first-years so patiently★
His eyes gleamed coldly, as if he were a completely different person.
"Then let's do this.
If you lose this game and die, I'll pay a visit to your house."
...What?
As I looked up, he grinned at me.
"If I tell them I'm your senior from the club, they'll surely serve me a cup of tea at least.
Then, when no one's looking, I'll drop the same capsule I made you swallow into your family's teacups."
"Wh... what a horrible thing to--!"
I yelled before I knew it.{p}

"Meaning once you're dead, I kill your family next. Good idea, huh?"
He was laughing.
Hino was laughing, having the time of his life.
It was the first time I had ever hated another person this much.
"Now, you want this antidote, don't you?"
I spat out my answer.{p}
I'd rather die than wag my tail for a coward like him!{p}

...But this isn't just my problem.
My family's lives are on the line too.{p}Even so, should I still refuse like a man?
I'll swallow my pride and say it after all
I just can't bring myself to say it
I bit my lip, then slowly opened my mouth.{p}

I just can't say it.
I don't want to say it.
There are some things a man just can't bend on, no matter what.
"D... do whatever you want!"{p}

"You cheeky little punk!"
Hosoda raised one pudgy arm.
But just then, Hino cut in.
"Now, hold on."
"Lord Hino..."
Hino winked at the disgruntled Hosoda.{p}

"You've got some backbone after all. I'm impressed.
In that case, maybe I'll change how I deal with you, too."
Hino picked up the ampoule between his fingers.
"Sorry for pulling such a dirty trick on a real man like you.
Here, take it."
T-take it? Easy for him to say.
My hands and feet were tied down tight.
Seeing me at a loss, Hino flashed a grin.{p}

"Here, catch."
The moment he said it, the ampoule slipped from Hino's fingers.
My breath stopped.
The little ampoule dropped straight toward the floor.
I twisted my body, trying somehow to catch it.
But it was just out of reach; the ampoule grazed my hand and fell.{p}

Crash!
Thin glass shattered with a sound so delicate it felt out of place.
The liquid inside spilled out and left a black stain on the floor.
I stared at it blankly.
No.
This can't be happening...{p}

"Hahaha, look at your face!"
Shindo pointed at me, looking like he couldn't stand how funny it was.{p}

Arai nodded with a smirk too.
"He looked just like a dog that bit into a piece of meat and found out it was made of wax, didn't he?"
My whole body burned hot.
These bastards are just playing with me!
If only my hands and feet were free, I'd lay into them.{p}

Hino shrugged.
"Oh, well. You went and wasted good medicine.
But hey, don't worry about it. There's one more ampoule."
"What? R... really★"{p}

"Really. It's hidden somewhere in this school.
About five hours until the poison kicks in... no, I guess it's only four and a half now.
You'd better find it before then."
Hino's words got another laugh.{p}

"N... no!"
I can't do that.
I have my pride too!
"Oh, is that so? Then shall I fix it so you can lick it?"
Hino snapped his fingers.{p}

Like mafia underlings in a movie, Hosoda and Arai moved without a sound.
They pinned my head and grabbed my jaw.
Their fingers dug into my cheeks.
With a nasty creak, my mouth was forced open.{p}

Hino shoved his shoe right into it.
"Mmgh☆"
"There, I'll let you off with this. Lucky for you I'm such a kind senior, huh, {a}?"
The smell of mud and dust spread through my mouth.
I wanted to throw up.
But I fought it with everything I had.
I didn't want these people to see me any more pathetic than this.
Instead, when Hino pulled his shoe back, I glared at him and spat.{p}
"You never learn, do you? What do you think you can do like this?"{p}

Shindo kicked me in the stomach.
"Gahh!"{p}
"See? You can't even dodge a kick. Try acting a little smarter."{p}
Shindo kicked me again and again as he said it.{p}

Shoulders, stomach, legs: every kick sent a searing pain through me.
He didn't even seem to be putting much into it; Shindo had to be pretty used to fighting.{p}

"Now, now, that's enough."
Laughing, Hino put a hand on Shindo's shoulder.{p}

"If Lord Hino says so."
Shindo bowed his head and meekly backed off.
Lord Hino?
What is with these people?
Are they into some weird cult or something?{p}

"You're too short-tempered. You nearly ruined everyone's fun."
At Hino's arrogant manner, even Shindo didn't say a word back.
"I'm terribly sorry..."
Was there some powerful bond between these seven that no outsider could understand?
Just then, I caught my breath.
I noticed the rope binding my arms had come pretty loose.
With this, I might be able to get away.
I looked up at them.{p}

They were all watching Hino.
I could tell they were tense and on edge, careful not to upset him.
Quietly, I slipped my arms out of the rope.
I had to untie the rope on my legs while I had the chance.
I twisted around.
It's okay, nobody's noticed yet.
After working them back and forth again and again, I finally got the rope loose.
I could probably slip out of it now.
I steadied my breathing and waited for the right moment.
"Listen, you will swear absolute obedience to my orders. Otherwise..."
Hino swung his arm in a wide arc.
Everyone's attention was on it.
It's now or never!
I sprang to my feet.
I made a dash for the door!
But just then, someone tripped me.
"Whoa★"
I stumbled.{p}
I lost my balance and crashed into a shelf.{p}

Behind me, they all burst out laughing at once.
"Oh man, you're such good entertainment. That's exactly the reaction I expected."
They were all roaring with laughter.
I bit my lip so hard it bled.
They're toying with me.
I'll never forgive these people, never☆
My fists clenched on their own.{p}

Hino was quick to notice.
"Want to throw a punch? Lay a hand on us and you're dead."
He was grinning.
"The antidote I've got on me is a fake.
The real ampoule is hidden somewhere in this school. I'm the only one who knows where.
Maybe you'd better not make me angry, huh?"
"Y... you coward☆"{p}
When I shouted, another roar of laughter went up.{p}

"You're on the receiving end of our grudge. This much is only fair.
And one more thing.
Don't you dare leave the school. If you try to, I'll get rid of the ampoule.
If nobody knows what poison it is, not even a hospital can do a thing to cure you.
The only way to save yourself is to find the ampoule hidden somewhere in this school. Got it!"
So they'd thought of every last detail.
Is there nothing I can do against them?{p}Maybe I should just throw it all away and lay into them.
"Anything but that!"{p}

"...Then I guess it can't be helped."
Hino grinned mischievously.
The moment he said it, the ampoule slipped from Hino's fingers.
My breath stopped.
The little ampoule dropped straight toward the floor.
I twisted my body, trying somehow to catch it.
But it was just out of reach; the ampoule grazed my hand and fell.{p}

Crash!

The liquid inside spilled out and left a black stain on the floor.
I stared at it blankly.
No.
This can't be happening...{p}

"Hahaha, look at your face!"
Shindo pointed at me, looking like he couldn't stand how funny it was.{p}

Arai nodded with a smirk too.
"He looked just like a dog that bit into a piece of meat and found out it was made of wax, didn't he?"
My whole body burned hot.
These bastards are just playing with me!
If only my hands and feet were free, I'd lay into them.{p}

Hino shrugged.
"Oh, well. You went and wasted good medicine.
But hey, don't worry about it. There's one more ampoule."
"What? R... really★"{p}

"Really. It's hidden somewhere in this school.
About five hours until the poison kicks in... no, I guess it's only four and a half now.
You'd better find it before then."
Hino's words got another laugh.
"Good luck, {a}!"
Careless cheers went up.{p}

My punch landed square in Hino's face as he stared, eyes wide.
I felt the crack all the way to the bone.
"Bwuh!"
Hino went flying.
Kazama and the others rushed to help him up.{p}

I was dragged down onto the floor.
"After laying a hand on me, you don't have the right to live one more minute."
Hino said it flatly.
A gleaming knife was clutched in his hand.
Just then, Fukuzawa leaned in to peer at Hino.{p}
"Hey, Lord Hino. If we're not playing the game, at least let me do the killing."{p}

"Oh, that's not fair! {a} is just my type. Let me do it too, please."
Iwashita cut in.{p}

Hino gave a wry smile.
"Can't be helped. Just do it together, then."
He handed the knife to the delighted girls.
Do these people think nothing of killing someone★{p}

Fukuzawa gave me a sweet smile.
"It's my first time. Sorry if I don't do it right."
An innocent smile.
She frightened me more than the thought of being killed.
"Don't finish it in one blow. I'm the one who gets to deal {a} the final stroke."
I heard Iwashita's voice.{p}

But right then, I couldn't check where she was.
Because at that moment, Fukuzawa's knife came plunging down on me.{p}

A heavy blow landed on my chest.
I could no longer see anything, not even Fukuzawa right in front of me.{p}

"...Ahahaha. That's more like it.
But you defied me a moment ago, didn't you?
I'll teach you what happens when you do that."
As Hino said it, they held me down.
Once again, they forced me to swallow something.{p}

"What you just swallowed is a drug that makes the poison work faster.
As a penalty for defying me, your time's been cut by thirty minutes."
Hino tossed a wristwatch over to me.
"Four hours thirty minus thirty minutes leaves you exactly four hours.
As a parting gift, you can have my precious wristwatch. It'd be a shame if you couldn't tell the time, right?
Now, hurry! Hurry up and drink the antidote!"{p}

"Hurry!"
"Hurry!"
"Hurry or you'll die!"
They all jeered at me together.
...I wanted to beat the hell out of them, but I didn't even have the time to spare for that.
For now, just like they said, finding the antidote came first.{p}
"Hurry, hurry, {a}! If you don't hurry, you're gonna diiiiie!"{p}
Hosoda, the fatso, pretended to run, huffing and puffing.{p}

Watching them only made me angrier.
I ran out of the newspaper club room.{p}

The cheers seeing me off stabbed into my back.
Shut up.
I felt like a marathon runner heading out of the stadium.
I looked at the watch Hino had given me.
It was digital.
It read eleven o'clock at night.
I set the watch's stopwatch.{p}

Exactly four hours left.
Now, hurry!{p}Where should I go first?
